source.acceptance: Thresholds: owner decision #162 5905899852. Points and credit: owner decision 2c (2026-09-30), admitted as Reference evidence; Canary and Crystal values are not used.

track: Progress is kept per (CharacterId, weapon Item key). A weapon has a track only when its Item carries a proficiency binding (content/proficiencies/bindings.json).

levels.rule: progress_thresholds[class][i] is the cumulative progress that reaches level i + 1. A definition with n perk levels (1..7) unlocks perk level k at threshold k. Mastery is level n + mastery_offset; it grants no perk. Progress saturates at the Mastery threshold.

credit.rule: Every character that contributed damage to the creature gains progress, as for Bestiary and Bosstiary progress. Only the weapon equipped at the creature's death gains it. A creature with no Bestiary or Bosstiary entry, and a summoned creature, give none.
credit.multi_principal: Waits for the multi-principal reward contract; until then the single reward principal of the death (COMBAT01-REWARD-PRINCIPALS) is credited, as Bestiary kill progress.

points.rule: A Bestiary creature gives creature_points[difficulty][stacks], where stacks is its influence stack count 0..5, or index 6 when it is fiendish. A Bosstiary boss gives boss_points[category] with no influence bonus. The table is copied as published, not computed.
points.not_evidenced: Soulpit bosses and proficiency catalysts give nothing until evidenced (PROFICIENCY-1).
